content.thinking: The conns have labels 0..2 but C=2 → labels must be in [0,1]. I need separate connections for the CNN test. Let me use simple connections with label 0/1.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='dev/f1test.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("cfg4['service'] = [1, 1]; cfg4['fallback'] = 1",
            "cfg4['service'] = [1, 1]; cfg4['fallback'] = 1\nconns2 = [{'id': 'x', 'slot': 0, 'label': 0, 'split': 'dev'},\n          {'id': 'y', 'slot': 1, 'label': 1, 'split': 'eval'}]")
s=s.replace("st = subm._validate({'version': 1, 'config': cfg4, 'model': mdl,\n                     'connections': conns, 'packets': pkts})",
            "st = subm._validate({'version': 1, 'config': cfg4, 'model': mdl,\n                     'connections': conns2, 'packets': pkts})")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
python3 dev/f1test.py 2>&1 | tail -4
